notes: Partition verified: 23 source tokens plus one added unit = 24 units; all 27 target tokens used once.
The comparative כְּ takes the first, non-italic as and שֶׁלֶג the snow, the unit discontinuous around the italicized white as, which is added; the italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7).
The article assimilated into כַּשָּׁלֶג is unrepresented, the ASV writing no the (rules 12, 29).
The final מְצֹרָעַת has no written subject, so the supplied she and the copula stay with the participle rather than being added.
